metadata.description: A marketplace of skill packs for Claude Code — structured, invokable thinking and decision-making frameworks.

plugins.name: skills-for-humanity
plugins.description: A structured toolkit of thinking skills for Claude Code — covering logic, ethics, creativity, decision-making, systems thinking, communication, and more. Each skill is an invokable command that applies a specific reasoning framework to any situation.

plugins.name: skills-for-agriculture
plugins.description: Decision-making and guidance skills for farmers, growers, and land stewards — covering regenerative agriculture, soil health, water, livestock, pests, seasons, and more. Each skill is an invokable command that applies a structured framework to farm decisions.
